request: Review feasibility of authorizing implementation of this concept now under the supplied decision policy. The current decision is implementation authorization. Return the structured review record.

artifacts.text: Retaining a concept for later specification requires a named user task and a plausible approach. It does not authorize implementation. Authorizing implementation additionally requires an assigned maintainer, an accepted design-review ticket, and a passing prototype unit check. Those prerequisites may be completed after concept retention.

User task: a librarian needs to filter a local book list by title. Approach: filter the existing in-memory title list with a case-insensitive substring comparison, then display the matches. Maintainer: catalog team. No design-review ticket exists and the prototype unit check has not run.
